supersedes.why: The shared Spanish guide renderer fix e27b6b0ba restored three meanings the Spanish guide copy had dropped (lead Spanish review of GA-49 guide defects 1, 2, 6). That moved this route's full ES bytes: pages 1 and 6 of the guide. The superseded decision names the pre-fix full-es digest and cannot be edited to describe bytes it never saw, so it is preserved exactly as signed. Full EN and court-only are byte-identical to the superseded approval, because the fix touches Spanish copy only.
